perks.name: Sinew Stitching
perks.description: Taking damage from combatants sometimes spawns a Threadling.
perks.exact:
Upon receiving ? damage from Combatants or upon reaching Critical Health:
Spawns a Threadling.
Incurs a 5 second cooldown between Threadling spawns from damage and a 5 second cooldown between Threadlings spawns from reaching Critical Health.

perks.name: Knit Together
perks.description: For a short time after your shields break, your next several Threadling hits restore health.
perks.exact:
Upon reaching Critical Health:
The next 3 Threadling hits within 10 seconds of reaching Critical Health restore 50? HP.
Incurs a 5 second cooldown afterwards.
